provider_note: No AI provider call was required for this deterministic structural batch; historical canonical owners and previously verified evidence classes were reused. No provider lineage is claimed.

range_fade.mechanism: bounded low-volatility range creates inventory/mean-reversion pressure at extremes; payer is late breakout/one-sided flow that fails to continue
range_fade.entry: closed-bar extreme-zone reclaim inside a bounded range with momentum exhaustion confirmation
range_fade.regime_no_trade: no trade outside bounded range, on stale/missing/duplicate data, or when cost budget is insufficient
range_fade.risk: ATR structural stop, fixed timeout, no adverse add or pyramiding
range_fade.execution_cost: verified round-trip cost authority mandatory before tradable intent
range_fade.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry controls plus range-regime permutation

fvg_revert.mechanism: short-lived price imbalance/gap can mean-revert when continuation fails; payer is late directional flow trapped after imbalance creation
fvg_revert.entry: closed-bar imbalance of material ATR size followed by opposite reclaim
fvg_revert.regime_no_trade: no qualifying gap/reclaim, stale/missing/duplicate source, or inadequate cost budget
fvg_revert.risk: ATR stop, 2R target proxy, timeout, no add/pyramiding
failure_modes: gap magnitude too small after costs
fvg_revert.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry and gap-size collapse controls

pivot_reversal.mechanism: recent swing levels concentrate resting/conditional liquidity; rejection wick plus close back from the level can mark failed continuation
pivot_reversal.entry: near recent pivot plus asymmetric rejection wick on a closed bar
pivot_reversal.regime_no_trade: not near pivot, weak rejection, stale/missing/duplicate source, or inadequate cost budget
pivot_reversal.risk: ATR structural stop, fixed timeout, no beam sizing/adds
pivot_reversal.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry and pivot-location permutation

rsi_swing_fail.mechanism: failed break of a recent swing combined with exhausted momentum can force late breakout participants to unwind
rsi_swing_fail.entry: closed-bar failed swing break with RSI exhaustion proxy
rsi_swing_fail.regime_no_trade: no failed break, neutral momentum, stale/missing/duplicate source, or inadequate cost budget
rsi_swing_fail.risk: ATR stop, fixed timeout, no averaging or pyramiding
failure_modes: RSI proxy is non-causal when used alone
swing definition unstable in high volatility
rsi_swing_fail.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry and swing-break permutation
